subject: or_legislature/2025R1/SB936
title: Makes a public health infrastructure facility an allowed use on any zone if the Oregon Health Authority, Department of Environmental Quality or United States Environmental Protection Agency has established a deadline for the development of the facility.
headline: SB 936 did not pass

claims.text: SB 936 was introduced in the Senate on January 23, 2025.
SB 936 was still in a Senate committee when the session ended. Last recorded step: June 27, 2025.
Each of the 3 recorded steps was checked against Oregon's chamber procedure and every move was a legal one.
